issuers.data_source: mempool.space chain stats for the Unit treasury output, snapshot 2026-10-24. Wrapped outstanding on HyperCore was not in the fixture.
issuers.label: estimate
issuers.method: QES bps = weighted_exposed_sats * 10000 // total_sats. P2TR counts as exposed because the key is in the output. Any other type counts as exposed only after a spent output. Single-key P2TR and spent P2WPKH keep weight 1. An m-of-n bucket keeps weight 1 until a threshold is configured, then weight m/n. MPC ECDSA/TSS stays classical and does not reduce the score. A fresh issuer attestation subtracts the configured reduction. One snapshot is that snapshot, not a time average.
